assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL professionally art-directed square background illustration for a premium anime character mobile hero card. BACKGROUND ONLY: absolutely NO people, faces, silhouette, lettering, logo, watermark or UI.
Art direction: "Rose Garden Theatre". Sophisticated contemporary decorative poster design with botanical Art Nouveau rhythm and rich animation color-key design. Strong colored shapes and elegant asymmetrical composition, not pastel wallpaper. Crisp carefully drawn contours, selective fine ink detailing on roses, flat opaque gouache colors with extremely subtle screenprint texture. Controlled, confident and eye-catching rather than overdecorated.

Color design: deep peacock teal #136E70 and dark petrol #174A4B contrasted against luminous warm ivory #FFF0CE, coral vermilion #EE6858, raspberry rose #BD4355 and small honey gold #E7B851. Saturated but sophisticated, with cool darks and warm lights. About 40% warm ivory, 35% teal/petrol, 20% coral/rose and 5% gold.

Composition is engineered for a real layout: LEFT text area x=7–51%, y=9–67% must be uninterrupted WARM IVORY for dark Chinese text; a subtly sculpted asymmetrical ivory opening shapes this negative space, seamlessly part of the illustrated garden, NOT a bordered panel or rectangle. RIGHT x=53–100%, y=17–100% is where a separate red-haired anime maid will be overlaid; leave the center of this area broad calm peacock teal with a warm honey arch behind her head. No flowers across the face region x=65–93%, y=20–49%.
Visual structure: a dramatic tall sweeping architectural garden arch on the upper RIGHT, with broad nested bands in peacock teal, warm ivory, and a narrow honey band, cropped by the top and right edges. No centered circle/sun disk. Rich petrol branches and oversized sculpted leaves frame the outer top and right edge. In the lower LEFT below 70% height: one striking cluster of three stylized open coral and raspberry roses, broad sea-green leaves and a sinuous golden stem. Flowers have designed layered petal shapes, not realistic photographs; their scale creates a strong focal accent visible on a phone. A bold coral curved foreground sweeps from lower left toward bottom right over deep teal at the bottom, creating depth and diagonal visual movement. One or two tiny amber buds echo the arch at the top LEFT edge, confined above 6% height. Broad overlapping color planes, intentional silhouettes, elegant contour rhythm, several precise fine lines of gold but no busy ornament wallpaper.
Mood: warm confident everyday greeting, a romantic illustrated garden full of life.
Do not generate a room, furniture, realistic photographic scenery, dusty beige wash, fog, faded low contrast, generic soft circles on blank paper, scattered confetti, excessive small details, rectangular frames, childish clipart, 3D rendering or gradients. Full bleed opaque square composition, 1254 by 1254. The background must carry memorable design and color even before a character is added.
